title: Eligible Specialties, Location Types and Office Site Review — Network Participation Agreements
content:
Each type of **Network Participation Agreements** may be held only by a provider whose specialty and office location type the agreement admits. Every agreement type also requires an active state license. Only the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement requires the office to pass a site review before approval.

## Admission table

| Agreement type | Specialties that may hold it | Location types | Office site review required before approval |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement | General dentist, pediatric dentist, orthodontist, endodontist, periodontist, oral surgeon, prosthodontist, optometrist, ophthalmologist | Private practice, retail chain | No |
| Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement | Optometrist, ophthalmologist | Private practice, retail chain | No |
| Cascade DHMO Specialist Agreement | Pediatric dentist, orthodontist, endodontist, periodontist, oral surgeon, prosthodontist | Private practice | No |
| Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement | General dentist, pediatric dentist | Private practice | Yes |
| Cascade Premier Participating Dentist Agreement | General dentist, pediatric dentist, orthodontist, endodontist, periodontist, oral surgeon, prosthodontist | Private practice | No |
| Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement | General dentist, pediatric dentist, orthodontist, endodontist, periodontist, oral surgeon, prosthodontist | Private practice | No |

## Points of judgement

- **Specialty and location are read together.** Both must be on the list for the agreement type. For example, an ophthalmologist at a retail chain may hold the vision network or savings network agreement, but no dental agreement.
- **Retail chain locations** are admitted only to the savings network and vision network agreements. Every dental agreement admits private practices only.
- **Primary care.** Only general dentists and pediatric dentists may hold the DHMO primary care dentist agreement. Specialists treat DHMO members on referral under the DHMO specialist agreement, which does not admit general dentists.
- **Site review.** Where the site review is required, a "Yes" in the last column, the agreement is approved only after the office passes it. A "No" means approval does not wait on a site review.

## Hypothetical cases

| Applicant (hypothetical) | Agreement applied for | Admissible by specialty and location? |
|---|---|---|
| Periodontist, private practice | Cascade DHMO Specialist Agreement | Yes |
| General dentist, private practice | Cascade DHMO Specialist Agreement | No — general dentist is not listed |
| Optometrist, retail chain | Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement | Yes |
| Pediatric dentist, retail chain | Cascade PPO Participating Dentist Agreement | No — retail chain is not listed |
